text:
maria_finance: Noticed a billing mismatch on MedBridge (private) renewal. Support billed as "Platinum" when PO and SOW both say "Standard". Platform fee also computed at 15% vs 10%.
jon_sales: ugh. Do you have invoice sample lines?
maria_finance: From invoice MB-2024-089:

```
Invoice lines billed:
1) OnPrem License - Standard - $120,000
2) Platform Fee (15%) - $18,000
3) Support (Platinum) - $30,000

Contract/SOW expected:
2) Platform Fee (10%) - $12,000
3) Support (Standard) - $15,000
```

maria_finance: Net delta = platform + support = ($6,000 + $15,000) = $21,000 pre-tax.
arun_ops: Did they accept any upgrade during renewal call? Ops notes show no add-ons. We didn't activate Platinum features.
jon_sales: I confirmed with the AM — customer never agreed to Platinum. This seems like a mapping error from the renewal form where a dropdown defaulted to Platinum.
maria_finance: Also note the invoice was auto-issued, applied, and paid in full. So we need a credit memo + ledger adjustment.
billing_bot: CREDIT PREVIEW -> Account: MEDBRIDGE | Credit total: $21,000 | Suggested apply: credit to next invoice OR refund. Outstanding balance: $0.00. If refund requested, route to finance ops. Reply `apply_credit` or `refund`.
jon_sales: They prefer a refund to the card on file. Can we do that?
maria_finance: Refunds > $10k require VP finance approval and 2FA on payout. Also need legal sign-off if customer disputes.
arun_ops: I'll create a short postmortem for the dropdown default. Ticket OPS-904.
jon_sales: Drafting customer message: short apology, explain system error on onboarding field default, refund $21k, and free support for 1 month. Any objections?
vp_finance: Quick q — is the $21k inclusive of any usage true-up or just SKU mis-class?
maria_finance: Just SKU mis-class. Usage meters align with Standard entitlement. No additional true-up.
vp_finance: Ok approve refund to card. Please capture approval note: "Refund approved VP Finance 1755554321. Reason: SKU misclassification on renewal form. Amount $21,000."
maria_finance: Approved and executed. Refund TXN REF-2024-311 created. Posted audit note on invoice MB-2024-089.
arun_ops: OPS-904 created to block defaulting to higher support tier and add a unit test on renewal UI. ETA: 2 business days.
jon_sales: Customer confirmed receipt of refund and replied: "Thanks for quick action. Please keep us posted on fix." :pray:
maria_finance: Closing thread. Will follow up once OPS-904 is resolved and confirm audit entries pushed to GL.
